fields.name: validEmailAddress
fields.description:
Whether the email address is formatted correctly.

Returns `true` when the email is formatted correctly and
belongs to an existing domain. This doesn't guarantee that
the email address actually exists.

fields.name: verifiedEmail
fields.description: Whether the customer has verified their email address. Defaults to `true` if the customer is created through the Shopify admin or API.

fields.name: acceptAutomaticDiscounts
fields.description:
Whether or not to accept automatic discounts on the draft order during calculation.
If false, only discount codes and custom draft order discounts (see `appliedDiscount`) will be applied.
If true, eligible automatic discounts will be applied in addition to discount codes and custom draft order discounts.

fields.name: allVariantPricesOverridden
fields.description: Whether all variant prices have been overridden.

fields.name: allowDiscountCodesInCheckout
fields.description: Whether discount codes are allowed during checkout of this draft order.

fields.name: anyVariantPricesOverridden
fields.description: Whether any variant prices have been overridden.

fields.name: appliedDiscount
fields.description: The custom order-level discount applied.

fields.name: billingAddress
fields.description: The billing address of the customer.

fields.name: billingAddressMatchesShippingAddress
fields.description: Whether the billing address matches the shipping address.

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description:
The date and time when the draft order was converted to a new order,
and had it's status changed to **Completed**.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The date and time when the draft order was created in Shopify.

fields.name: currencyCode
fields.description: The shop currency used for calculation.

fields.name: customAttributes
fields.description: The custom information added to the draft order on behalf of the customer.

fields.name: customer
fields.description: The customer who will be sent an invoice.

fields.name: defaultCursor
fields.description: A default [cursor](https://shopify.dev/api/usage/pagination-graphql) that returns the single next record, sorted ascending by ID.

fields.name: discountCodes
fields.description: All discount codes applied.

fields.name: email
fields.description: The email address of the customer, which is used to send notifications.

fields.name: events
fields.description: The list of events associated with the draft order.

fields.name: hasTimelineComment
fields.description: Whether the merchant has added timeline comments to the draft order.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: invoiceEmailTemplateSubject
fields.description: The subject defined for the draft invoice email template.

fields.name: invoiceSentAt
fields.description: The date and time when the invoice was last emailed to the customer.

fields.name: invoiceUrl
fields.description: The link to the checkout, which is sent to the customer in the invoice email.

fields.name: legacyResourceId
fields.description: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

fields.name: lineItems
fields.description: The list of the line items in the draft order.

fields.name: lineItemsSubtotalPrice
fields.description:
A subtotal of the line items and corresponding discounts,
excluding include shipping charges, shipping discounts, taxes, or order discounts.

fields.name: localizationExtensions
fields.description: List of localization extensions for the resource.
fields.deprecationReason: This connection will be removed in a future version. Use `localizedFields` instead.

fields.name: localizedFields
fields.description: List of localized fields for the resource.

fields.name: marketName
fields.description: The name of the selected market.
fields.deprecationReason: This field is now incompatible with Markets.

fields.name: marketRegionCountryCode
fields.description: The selected country code that determines the pricing.
fields.deprecationReason: This field is now incompatible with Markets.

fields.name: metafield
fields.description:
A [custom field](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data),
including its `namespace` and `key`, that's associated with a Shopify resource
for the purposes of adding and storing additional information.

fields.name: metafields
fields.description:
A list of [custom fields](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data)
that a merchant associates with a Shopify resource.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The identifier for the draft order, which is unique within the store. For example, _#D1223_.

fields.name: note2
fields.description: The text from an optional note attached to the draft order.

fields.name: order
fields.description: The order that was created from the draft order.

fields.name: paymentTerms
fields.description: The associated payment terms for this draft order.

fields.name: phone
fields.description: The assigned phone number.

fields.name: platformDiscounts
fields.description: The list of platform discounts applied.

fields.name: poNumber
fields.description: The purchase order number.

fields.name: presentmentCurrencyCode
fields.description: The payment currency used for calculation.

fields.name: purchasingEntity
fields.description: The purchasing entity.

fields.name: ready
fields.description:
Whether the draft order is ready and can be completed.
Draft orders might have asynchronous operations that can take time to finish.

fields.name: reserveInventoryUntil
fields.description: The time after which inventory will automatically be restocked.

fields.name: shippingAddress
fields.description: The shipping address of the customer.

fields.name: shippingLine
fields.description: The line item containing the shipping information and costs.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The status of the draft order.

fields.name: subtotalPrice
fields.description: The subtotal, in shop currency, of the line items and their discounts, excluding shipping charges, shipping discounts, and taxes.

fields.name: subtotalPriceSet
fields.description: The subtotal, of the line items and their discounts, excluding shipping charges, shipping discounts, and taxes.

fields.name: tags
fields.description:
The comma separated list of tags associated with the draft order.
Updating `tags` overwrites any existing tags that were previously added to the draft order.
To add new tags without overwriting existing tags, use the [tagsAdd](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/tagsadd) mutation.

fields.name: taxExempt
fields.description: Whether the draft order is tax exempt.

fields.name: taxLines
fields.description: The list of of taxes lines charged for each line item and shipping line.

fields.name: taxesIncluded
fields.description: Whether the line item prices include taxes.

fields.name: totalDiscountsSet
fields.description: Total discounts.

fields.name: totalLineItemsPriceSet
fields.description: Total price of line items.

fields.name: totalPrice
fields.description: The total price, in shop currency, includes taxes, shipping charges, and discounts.

fields.name: totalPriceSet
fields.description: The total price, includes taxes, shipping charges, and discounts.

fields.name: totalQuantityOfLineItems
fields.description:
The sum of individual line item quantities.
If the draft order has bundle items, this is the sum containing the quantities of individual items in the bundle.

fields.name: totalShippingPrice
fields.description: The total shipping price in shop currency.

fields.name: totalShippingPriceSet
fields.description: The total shipping price.

fields.name: totalTax
fields.description: The total tax in shop currency.

fields.name: totalTaxSet
fields.description: The total tax.

fields.name: totalWeight
fields.description: The total weight in grams of the draft order.

fields.name: transformerFingerprint
fields.description:
Fingerprint of the current cart.
In order to have bundles work, the fingerprint must be passed to
each request as it was previously returned, unmodified.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description:
The date and time when the draft order was last changed.
The format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss. For example, 2016-02-05 17:04:01.

fields.name: visibleToCustomer
fields.description: Whether the draft order will be visible to the customer on the self-serve portal.

fields.name: warnings
fields.description: The list of warnings raised while calculating.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The date and time when the fulfillment was created.

fields.name: deliveredAt
fields.description: The date that this fulfillment was delivered.

fields.name: displayStatus
fields.description: Human readable display status for this fulfillment.

fields.name: estimatedDeliveryAt
fields.description: The estimated date that this fulfillment will arrive.

fields.name: events
fields.description: The history of events associated with this fulfillment.

fields.name: fulfillmentLineItems
fields.description: List of the fulfillment's line items.

fields.name: fulfillmentOrders
fields.description: A paginated list of fulfillment orders for the fulfillment.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: inTransitAt
fields.description: The date and time when the fulfillment went into transit.

fields.name: legacyResourceId
fields.description: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

fields.name: location
fields.description: The location that the fulfillment was processed at.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human readable reference identifier for this fulfillment.

fields.name: order
fields.description: The order for which the fulfillment was created.

fields.name: originAddress
fields.description: The address at which the fulfillment occurred. This field is intended for tax purposes, as a full address is required for tax providers to accurately calculate taxes. Typically this is the address of the warehouse or fulfillment center. To retrieve a fulfillment location's address, use the `assignedLocation` field on the [`FulfillmentOrder`](/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/FulfillmentOrder) object instead.

fields.name: requiresShipping
fields.description: Whether any of the line items in the fulfillment require shipping.

fields.name: service
fields.description: Fulfillment service associated with the fulfillment.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The status of the fulfillment.

fields.name: totalQuantity
fields.description: Sum of all line item quantities for the fulfillment.

fields.name: trackingInfo
fields.description:
Tracking information associated with the fulfillment,
such as the tracking company, tracking number, and tracking URL.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: The date and time when the fulfillment was last modified.

fields.name: countryCodeOfOrigin
fields.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of where the item originated from.

fields.name: countryHarmonizedSystemCodes
fields.description: A list of country specific harmonized system codes.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The date and time when the inventory item was created.

fields.name: duplicateSkuCount
fields.description: The number of inventory items that share the same SKU with this item.

fields.name: harmonizedSystemCode
fields.description: The harmonized system code of the item. This must be a number between 6 and 13 digits.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: inventoryHistoryUrl
fields.description: The URL that points to the inventory history for the item.

fields.name: inventoryLevel
fields.description: The inventory item's quantities at the specified location.

fields.name: inventoryLevels
fields.description: A list of the inventory item's quantities for each location that the inventory item can be stocked at.

fields.name: legacyResourceId
fields.description: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

fields.name: locationsCount
fields.description: The number of locations where this inventory item is stocked.

fields.name: measurement
fields.description: The packaging dimensions of the inventory item.

fields.name: provinceCodeOfOrigin
fields.description: The ISO 3166-2 alpha-2 province code of where the item originated from.

fields.name: requiresShipping
fields.description: Whether the inventory item requires shipping.

fields.name: sku
fields.description: Inventory item SKU. Case-sensitive string.

fields.name: tracked
fields.description: Whether inventory levels are tracked for the item.

fields.name: trackedEditable
fields.description: Whether the value of the `tracked` field for the inventory item can be changed.

fields.name: unitCost
fields.description: Unit cost associated with the inventory item. Note: the user must have "View product costs" permission granted in order to access this field once product granular permissions are enabled.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: The date and time when the inventory item was updated.

fields.name: variant
fields.description: The variant that owns this inventory item.

fields.name: activatable
fields.description:
Whether the location can be reactivated. If `false`, then trying to activate the location with the
[`LocationActivate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/locationActivate)
mutation will return an error that describes why the location can't be activated.

fields.name: address
fields.description: The address of this location.

fields.name: addressVerified
fields.description: Whether the location address has been verified.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The date and time ([ISO 8601 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)) that the location was added to a shop.

fields.name: deactivatable
fields.description:
Whether this location can be deactivated. If `true`, then the location can be deactivated by calling the
[`LocationDeactivate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/locationDeactivate)
mutation. If `false`, then calling the mutation to deactivate it will return an error that describes why the
location can't be deactivated.

fields.name: deactivatedAt
fields.description: The date and time ([ISO 8601 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)) that the location was deactivated at. For example, 3:30 pm on September 7, 2019 in the time zone of UTC (Universal Time Coordinated) is represented as `"2019-09-07T15:50:00Z`".

fields.name: deletable
fields.description: Whether this location can be deleted.

fields.name: fulfillmentService
fields.description: Name of the service provider that fulfills from this location.

fields.name: fulfillsOnlineOrders
fields.description: Whether this location can fulfill online orders.

fields.name: hasActiveInventory
fields.description: Whether this location has active inventory.

fields.name: hasUnfulfilledOrders
fields.description: Whether this location has orders that need to be fulfilled.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: inventoryLevel
fields.description: The quantities of an inventory item at this location.

fields.name: inventoryLevels
fields.description: A list of the quantities of the inventory items that can be stocked at this location.

fields.name: isActive
fields.description:
Whether the location is active. A deactivated location can be activated (change `isActive: true`) if it has
`activatable` set to `true` by calling the
[`locationActivate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/locationActivate)
mutation.

fields.name: isFulfillmentService
fields.description: Whether this location is a fulfillment service.

fields.name: isPrimary
fields.description: Whether the location is your primary location for shipping inventory.
fields.deprecationReason: The concept of a primary location is deprecated, shipsInventory can be used to get a fallback location

fields.name: legacyResourceId
fields.description: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

fields.name: localPickupSettingsV2
fields.description: Local pickup settings for the location.

fields.name: metafield
fields.description:
A [custom field](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data),
including its `namespace` and `key`, that's associated with a Shopify resource
for the purposes of adding and storing additional information.

fields.name: metafieldDefinitions
fields.description: List of metafield definitions.
fields.deprecationReason: This field will be removed in a future version. Use `QueryRoot.metafieldDefinitions` instead.

fields.name: metafields
fields.description:
A list of [custom fields](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data)
that a merchant associates with a Shopify resource.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the location.

fields.name: shipsInventory
fields.description: Whether this location is used for calculating shipping rates. In multi-origin shipping mode, this flag is ignored.

fields.name: suggestedAddresses
fields.description: List of suggested addresses for this location (empty if none).

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: The date and time ([ISO 8601 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)) when the location was last updated.

fields.name: app
fields.description: The app that the marketing event is attributed to.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: The medium through which the marketing activity and event reached consumers. This is used for reporting aggregation.

fields.name: channelHandle
fields.description: The unique string identifier of the channel to which this activity belongs. For the correct handle for your channel, contact your partner manager.

fields.name: description
fields.description: A human-readable description of the marketing event.

fields.name: endedAt
fields.description: The date and time when the marketing event ended.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: legacyResourceId
fields.description: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

fields.name: manageUrl
fields.description: The URL where the marketing event can be managed.

fields.name: marketingChannelType
fields.description: The medium through which the marketing activity and event reached consumers. This is used for reporting aggregation.

fields.name: previewUrl
fields.description: The URL where the marketing event can be previewed.

fields.name: remoteId
fields.description: An optional ID that helps Shopify validate engagement data.

fields.name: scheduledToEndAt
fields.description: The date and time when the marketing event is scheduled to end.

fields.name: sourceAndMedium
fields.description:
Where the `MarketingEvent` occurred and what kind of content was used.
Because `utmSource` and `utmMedium` are often used interchangeably, this is
based on a combination of `marketingChannel`, `referringDomain`, and `type` to
provide a consistent representation for any given piece of marketing
regardless of the app that created it.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.description: The date and time when the marketing event started.

fields.name: targetTypeDisplayText
fields.description: The display text for the marketing event type.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The marketing event type.

fields.name: utmCampaign
fields.description: The name of the marketing campaign.

fields.name: utmMedium
fields.description: The medium that the marketing campaign is using. Example values: `cpc`, `banner`.

fields.name: utmSource
fields.description: The referrer of the marketing event. Example values: `google`, `newsletter`.

fields.name: compareDigest
fields.description: The data stored in the resource, represented as a digest.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The date and time when the metafield was created.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: The metafield definition that the metafield belongs to, if any.

fields.name: description
fields.description: The description of the metafield.
fields.deprecationReason: This field will be removed in a future release. Use the `description` on the metafield definition instead.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: jsonValue
fields.description: The data stored in the metafield in JSON format.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The unique identifier for the metafield within its namespace.

fields.name: legacyResourceId
fields.description: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

fields.name: namespace
fields.description: The container for a group of metafields that the metafield is associated with.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: The resource that the metafield is attached to.

fields.name: ownerType
fields.description: The type of resource that the metafield is attached to.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Returns a reference object if the metafield definition's type is a resource reference.

fields.name: references
fields.description: A list of reference objects if the metafield's type is a resource reference list.

fields.name: type
fields.description:
The type of data that is stored in the metafield.
Refer to the list of [supported types](https://shopify.dev/apps/metafields/types).

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: The date and time when the metafield was updated.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The data stored in the metafield. Always stored as a string, regardless of the metafield's type.

fields.name: additionalFees
fields.description: A list of additional fees applied to an order, such as duties, import fees, or [tax lines](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/order#field-Order.fields.additionalFees.taxLines).

fields.name: agreements
fields.description: A list of sales agreements associated with the order, such as contracts defining payment terms, or delivery schedules between merchants and customers.

fields.name: alerts
fields.description: A list of messages that appear on the **Orders** page in the Shopify admin. These alerts provide merchants with important information about an order's status or required actions.

fields.name: app
fields.description:
The application that created the order. For example, "Online Store", "Point of Sale", or a custom app name.
Use this to identify the order source for attribution and fulfillment workflows.
Learn more about [building apps for orders and fulfillment](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/orders-fulfillment).

fields.name: billingAddress
fields.description:
The billing address associated with the payment method selected by the customer for an order.
Returns `null` if no billing address was provided during checkout.

fields.name: billingAddressMatchesShippingAddress
fields.description: Whether the billing address matches the [shipping address](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/order#field-Order.fields.shippingAddress). Returns `true` if both addresses are the same, and `false` if they're different or if an address is missing.

fields.name: canMarkAsPaid
fields.description: Whether an order can be manually marked as paid. Returns `false` if the order is already paid, is canceled, has pending [Shopify Payments](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/payments/shopify-payments/payouts) transactions, or has a negative payment amount.

fields.name: canNotifyCustomer
fields.description:
Whether order notifications can be sent to the customer.
Returns `true` if the customer has a valid [email address](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/order#field-Order.fields.email).

fields.name: cancelReason
fields.description: The reason provided for an order cancellation. For example, a merchant might cancel an order if there's insufficient inventory. Returns `null` if the order hasn't been canceled.

fields.name: cancellation
fields.description: Details of an order's cancellation, if it has been canceled. This includes the reason, date, and any [staff notes](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/OrderCancellation#field-OrderCancellation.fields.staffNote).

fields.name: cancelledAt
fields.description:
The date and time in [ISO 8601 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) when an order was canceled.
Returns `null` if the order hasn't been canceled.

fields.name: capturable
fields.description:
Whether an authorized payment for an order can be captured.
Returns `true` if an authorized payment exists that hasn't been fully captured yet. Learn more about [capturing payments](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/fulfillment/managing-orders/payments/capturing-payments).

fields.name: cartDiscountAmount
fields.description: The total discount amount that applies to the entire order in shop currency, before returns, refunds, order edits, and cancellations.

fields.name: cartDiscountAmountSet
fields.description: The total discount amount applied at the time the order was created, displayed in both shop and presentment currencies, before returns, refunds, order edits, and cancellations. This field only includes discounts applied to the entire order.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: The sales channel from which an order originated, such as the [Online Store](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/app-surfaces#online-store) or [Shopify POS](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/app-surfaces#point-of-sale).

fields.name: channelInformation
fields.description:
Details about the sales channel that created the order, such as the [channel app type](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/channel#field-Channel.fields.channelType)
and [channel name](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/ChannelDefinition#field-ChannelDefinition.fields.channelName), which helps to track order sources.

fields.name: clientIp
fields.description: The IP address of the customer who placed the order. Useful for fraud detection and geographic analysis.

fields.name: closed
fields.description: Whether an order is closed. An order is considered closed if all its line items have been fulfilled or canceled, and all financial transactions are complete.

fields.name: closedAt
fields.description: The date and time [ISO 8601 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) when an order was closed. Shopify automatically records this timestamp when all items have been fulfilled or canceled, and all financial transactions are complete. Returns `null` if the order isn't closed.

fields.name: confirmationNumber
fields.description:
A customer-facing order identifier, often shown instead of the sequential order name.
It uses a random alphanumeric format (for example, `XPAV284CT`) and isn't guaranteed to be unique across orders.

fields.name: confirmed
fields.description:
Whether inventory has been reserved for an order. Returns `true` if inventory quantities for an order's [line items](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/LineItem) have been reserved.
Learn more about [managing inventory quantities and states](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/orders-fulfillment/inventory-management-apps/manage-quantities-states).

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The date and time in [ISO 8601 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) when an order was created. This timestamp is set when the customer completes checkout and remains unchanged throughout an order's lifecycle.

fields.name: currencyCode
fields.description: The shop currency when the order was placed. For example, "USD" or "CAD".

fields.name: currentCartDiscountAmountSet
fields.description: The current total of all discounts applied to the entire order, after returns, refunds, order edits, and cancellations. This includes discount codes, automatic discounts, and other promotions that affect the whole order rather than individual line items. To get the original discount amount at the time of order creation, use the [`cartDiscountAmountSet`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/order#field-Order.fields.cartDiscountAmountSet) field.

fields.name: currentShippingPriceSet
fields.description:
The current shipping price after applying refunds and discounts.
If the parent `order.taxesIncluded` field is true, then this price includes taxes. Otherwise, this field is the pre-tax price.

fields.name: currentSubtotalLineItemsQuantity
fields.description: The current sum of the quantities for all line items that contribute to the order's subtotal price, after returns, refunds, order edits, and cancellations.

fields.name: currentSubtotalPriceSet
fields.description:
The total price of the order, after returns and refunds, in shop and presentment currencies.
This includes taxes and discounts.

fields.name: currentTaxLines
fields.description:
A list of all tax lines applied to line items on the order, after returns.
Tax line prices represent the total price for all tax lines with the same `rate` and `title`.

fields.name: currentTotalAdditionalFeesSet
fields.description: The current total of all additional fees for an order, after any returns or modifications. Modifications include returns, refunds, order edits, and cancellations. Additional fees can include charges such as duties, import fees, and special handling.

fields.name: currentTotalDiscountsSet
fields.description:
The total amount discounted on the order after returns and refunds, in shop and presentment currencies.
This includes both order and line level discounts.

fields.name: currentTotalDutiesSet
fields.description: The current total duties amount for an order, after any returns or modifications. Modifications include returns, refunds, order edits, and cancellations.

fields.name: currentTotalPriceSet
fields.description:
The total price of the order, after returns, in shop and presentment currencies.
This includes taxes and discounts.

fields.name: currentTotalTaxSet
fields.description: The sum of the prices of all tax lines applied to line items on the order, after returns and refunds, in shop and presentment currencies.

fields.name: currentTotalWeight
fields.description: The total weight of the order after returns and refunds, in grams.

fields.name: customAttributes
fields.description: A list of additional information that has been attached to the order. For example, gift message, delivery instructions, or internal notes.

fields.name: customer
fields.description:
The customer who placed an order. Returns `null` if an order was created through a checkout without customer authentication, such as a guest checkout.
Learn more about [customer accounts](https://help.shopify.com/manual/customers/customer-accounts).

fields.name: customerAcceptsMarketing
fields.description:
Whether the customer agreed to receive marketing emails at the time of purchase.
Use this to ensure compliance with marketing consent laws and to segment customers for email campaigns.
Learn more about [building customer segments](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/marketing-analytics/customer-segments).

fields.name: customerJourney
fields.description: The customer's visits and interactions with the online store before placing the order.

fields.name: customerJourneySummary
fields.description:
The customer's visits and interactions with the online store before placing the order.
Use this to understand customer behavior, attribution sources, and marketing effectiveness to optimize your sales funnel.

fields.name: customerLocale
fields.description:
The customer's language and region preference at the time of purchase. For example, "en" for English, "fr-CA" for French (Canada), or "es-MX" for Spanish (Mexico).
Use this to provide localized customer service and targeted marketing in the customer's preferred language.

fields.name: discountApplications
fields.description:
A list of discounts that are applied to the order, excluding order edits and refunds.
Includes discount codes, automatic discounts, and other promotions that reduce the order total.

fields.name: discountCode
fields.description: The discount code used for an order. Returns `null` if no discount code was applied.

fields.name: discountCodes
fields.description: The discount codes used for the order. Multiple codes can be applied to a single order.

fields.name: displayAddress
fields.description:
The primary address of the customer, prioritizing shipping address over billing address when both are available.
Returns `null` if neither shipping address nor billing address was provided.

fields.name: displayFinancialStatus
fields.description: An order's financial status for display in the Shopify admin.

fields.name: displayFulfillmentStatus
fields.description:
The order's fulfillment status that displays in the Shopify admin to merchants. For example, an order might be unfulfilled or scheduled.
For detailed processing, use the [`FulfillmentOrder`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/FulfillmentOrder) object.

fields.name: disputes
fields.description:
A list of payment disputes associated with the order, such as chargebacks or payment inquiries.
Disputes occur when customers challenge transactions with their bank or payment provider.

fields.name: dutiesIncluded
fields.description:
Whether duties are included in the subtotal price of the order.
Duties are import taxes charged by customs authorities when goods cross international borders.

fields.name: edited
fields.description: Whether the order has had any edits applied. For example, adding or removing line items, updating quantities, or changing prices.

fields.name: email
fields.description:
The email address associated with the customer for this order.
Used for sending order confirmations, shipping notifications, and other order-related communications.
Returns `null` if no email address was provided during checkout.

fields.name: estimatedTaxes
fields.description:
Whether taxes on the order are estimated.
This field returns `false` when taxes on the order are finalized and aren't subject to any changes.

fields.name: events
fields.description: A list of events associated with the order. Events track significant changes and activities related to the order, such as creation, payment, fulfillment, and cancellation.

fields.name: exchangeV2s
fields.description: A list of ExchangeV2s for the order.

fields.name: fulfillable
fields.description:
Whether there are line items that can be fulfilled.
This field returns `false` when the order has no fulfillable line items.
For a more granular view of the fulfillment status, refer to the [FulfillmentOrder](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/FulfillmentOrder) object.

fields.name: fulfillmentOrders
fields.description:
A list of [fulfillment orders](https://shopify.dev/apps/fulfillment/fulfillment-service-apps/fulfillment-order) for an order. Each fulfillment order groups [line items](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/OrderLineItem) that are fulfilled together,
allowing an order to be processed in parts if needed.

fields.name: fulfillments
fields.description: A list of shipments for the order. Fulfillments represent the physical shipment of products to customers.

fields.name: fulfillmentsCount
fields.description: The total number of fulfillments for the order, including canceled ones.

fields.name: fullyPaid
fields.description: Whether the order has been paid in full. This field returns `true` when the total amount received equals or exceeds the order total.

fields.name: hasTimelineComment
fields.description: Whether the merchant has added a timeline comment to the order.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: landingPageDisplayText
fields.description: The URL of the first page of the online store that the customer visited before they submitted the order.

fields.name: landingPageUrl
fields.description: The first page of the online store that the customer visited before they submitted the order.

fields.name: legacyResourceId
fields.description: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

fields.name: lineItems
fields.description: A list of the order's line items. Line items represent the individual products and quantities that make up the order.

fields.name: localizationExtensions
fields.description: List of localization extensions for the resource.
fields.deprecationReason: This connection will be removed in a future version. Use `localizedFields` instead.

fields.name: localizedFields
fields.description: List of localized fields for the resource.

fields.name: merchantBusinessEntity
fields.description:
The legal business structure that the merchant operates under for this order, such as an LLC, corporation, or partnership.
Used for tax reporting, legal compliance, and determining which business entity is responsible for the order.

fields.name: merchantEditable
fields.description: Whether the order can be edited by the merchant. Returns `false` for orders that can't be modified, such as canceled orders or orders with specific payment statuses.

fields.name: merchantEditableErrors
fields.description: A list of reasons why the order can't be edited. For example, canceled orders can't be edited.

fields.name: merchantOfRecordApp
fields.description: The application acting as the Merchant of Record for the order. The Merchant of Record is responsible for tax collection and remittance.

fields.name: metafield
fields.description:
A [custom field](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data),
including its `namespace` and `key`, that's associated with a Shopify resource
for the purposes of adding and storing additional information.

fields.name: metafieldDefinitions
fields.description: List of metafield definitions.
fields.deprecationReason: This field will be removed in a future version. Use `QueryRoot.metafieldDefinitions` instead.

fields.name: metafields
fields.description:
A list of [custom fields](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data)
that a merchant associates with a Shopify resource.

fields.name: name
fields.description:
The unique identifier for the order that appears on the order page in the Shopify admin and the **Order status** page.
For example, "#1001", "EN1001", or "1001-A".
This value isn't unique across multiple stores. Use this field to identify orders in the Shopify admin and for order tracking.

fields.name: netPayment
fields.description: The net payment for the order, based on the total amount received minus the total amount refunded, in shop currency.

fields.name: netPaymentSet
fields.description: The net payment for the order, based on the total amount received minus the total amount refunded, in shop and presentment currencies.

fields.name: nonFulfillableLineItems
fields.description:
A list of line items that can't be fulfilled.
For example, tips and fully refunded line items can't be fulfilled.
For a more granular view of the fulfillment status, refer to the [FulfillmentOrder](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/FulfillmentOrder) object.

fields.name: note
fields.description:
The note associated with the order.
Contains additional information or instructions added by merchants or customers during the order process.
Commonly used for special delivery instructions, gift messages, or internal processing notes.

fields.name: originalTotalAdditionalFeesSet
fields.description:
The total amount of all additional fees, such as import fees or taxes, that were applied when an order was created.
Returns `null` if additional fees aren't applicable.

fields.name: originalTotalDutiesSet
fields.description: The total amount of duties calculated when an order was created, before any modifications. Modifications include returns, refunds, order edits, and cancellations. Use [`currentTotalDutiesSet`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/order#field-Order.fields.currentTotalDutiesSet) to retrieve the current duties amount after adjustments.

fields.name: originalTotalPriceSet
fields.description:
The total price of the order at the time of order creation, in shop and presentment currencies.
Use this to compare the original order value against the current total after edits, returns, or refunds.

fields.name: paymentCollectionDetails
fields.description:
The payment collection details for the order, including payment status, outstanding amounts, and collection information.
Use this to understand when and how payments should be collected, especially for orders with deferred or installment payment terms.

fields.name: paymentGatewayNames
fields.description:
A list of the names of all payment gateways used for the order.
For example, "Shopify Payments" and "Cash on Delivery (COD)".

fields.name: paymentTerms
fields.description: The payment terms associated with the order, such as net payment due dates or early payment discounts. Payment terms define when and how an order should be paid. Returns `null` if no specific payment terms were set for the order.

fields.name: phone
fields.description:
The phone number associated with the customer for this order.
Useful for contacting customers about shipping updates, delivery notifications, or order issues.
Returns `null` if no phone number was provided during checkout.

fields.name: physicalLocation
fields.description:
The fulfillment location that was assigned when the order was created.
Orders can have multiple fulfillment orders. These fulfillment orders can each be assigned to a different location which is responsible for fulfilling a subset of the items in an order. The `Order.physicalLocation` field will only point to one of these locations.
Use the [`FulfillmentOrder`](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/fulfillmentorder)
object for up to date fulfillment location information.
fields.deprecationReason: Use `fulfillmentOrders` to get the fulfillment location for the order

fields.name: poNumber
fields.description:
The purchase order (PO) number that's associated with an order.
This is typically provided by business customers who require a PO number for their procurement.

fields.name: presentmentCurrencyCode
fields.description:
The currency used by the customer when placing the order. For example, "USD", "EUR", or "CAD".
This may differ from the shop's base currency when serving international customers or using multi-currency pricing.

fields.name: processedAt
fields.description:
The date and time in [ISO 8601 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) when the order was processed.
This date and time might not match the date and time when the order was created.

fields.name: publication
fields.description: The sales channel that the order was created from, such as the [Online Store](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/app-surfaces#online-store) or [Shopify POS](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/app-surfaces#point-of-sale).

fields.name: purchasingEntity
fields.description:
The business entity that placed the order, including company details and purchasing relationships.
Used for B2B transactions to track which company or organization is responsible for the purchase and payment terms.

fields.name: referralCode
fields.description:
The marketing referral code from the link that the customer clicked to visit the store.
Supports the following URL attributes: "ref", "source", or "r".
For example, if the URL is `{shop}.myshopify.com/products/slide?ref=j2tj1tn2`, then this value is `j2tj1tn2`.

fields.name: referrerDisplayText
fields.description: A web domain or short description of the source that sent the customer to your online store. For example, "shopify.com" or "email".

fields.name: referrerUrl
fields.description: The URL of the webpage where the customer clicked a link that sent them to your online store.

fields.name: refundDiscrepancySet
fields.description:
The difference between the suggested and actual refund amount of all refunds that have been applied to the order.
A positive value indicates a difference in the merchant's favor, and a negative value indicates a difference in the customer's favor.

fields.name: refundable
fields.description:
Whether the order can be refunded based on its payment transactions.
Returns `false` for orders with no eligible payment transactions, such as fully refunded orders or orders with non-refundable payment methods.

fields.name: refunds
fields.description:
A list of refunds that have been applied to the order.
Refunds represent money returned to customers for returned items, cancellations, or adjustments.

fields.name: registeredSourceUrl
fields.description: The URL of the source that the order originated from, if found in the domain registry. Returns `null` if the source URL isn't in the domain registry.

fields.name: requiresShipping
fields.description:
Whether the order requires physical shipping to the customer.
Returns `false` for digital-only orders (such as gift cards or downloadable products) and `true` for orders with physical products that need delivery.
Use this to determine shipping workflows and logistics requirements.

fields.name: restockable
fields.description:
Whether any line items on the order can be restocked into inventory.
Returns `false` for digital products, custom items, or items that can't be resold.

fields.name: retailLocation
fields.description: The physical location where a retail order is created or completed, except for draft POS orders completed using the "mark as paid" flow in the Shopify admin, which return `null`. Transactions associated with the order might have been processed at a different location.

fields.name: returnStatus
fields.description:
The order's aggregated return status for display purposes.
Indicates the overall state of returns for the order, helping merchants track and manage the return process.

fields.name: returns
fields.description:
The returns associated with the order.
Contains information about items that customers have requested to return, including return reasons, status, and refund details.
Use this to track and manage the return process for order items.

fields.name: risk
fields.description:
The risk assessment summary for the order.
Provides fraud analysis and risk scoring to help you identify potentially fraudulent orders.
Use this to make informed decisions about order fulfillment and payment processing.

fields.name: riskLevel
fields.description: The fraud risk level of the order.
fields.deprecationReason: This field is deprecated in favor of OrderRiskAssessment.riskLevel which allows for more granular risk levels, including PENDING and NONE.

fields.name: risks
fields.description: A list of risks associated with the order.
fields.deprecationReason: This field is deprecated in favor of OrderRiskAssessment, which provides enhanced capabilities such as distinguishing risks from their provider.

fields.name: shippingAddress
fields.description:
The shipping address where the order will be delivered.
Contains the customer's delivery location for fulfillment and shipping label generation.
Returns `null` for digital orders or orders that don't require shipping.

fields.name: shippingLine
fields.description:
A summary of all shipping costs on the order.
Aggregates shipping charges, discounts, and taxes to provide a single view of delivery costs.

fields.name: shippingLines
fields.description:
The shipping methods applied to the order.
Each shipping line represents a shipping option chosen during checkout, including the carrier, service level, and cost.
Use this to understand shipping charges and delivery options for the order.

fields.name: shopifyProtect
fields.description:
The Shopify Protect details for the order, including fraud protection status and coverage information.
Shopify Protect helps protect eligible orders against fraudulent chargebacks.
Returns `null` if Shopify Protect is disabled for the shop or the order isn't eligible for protection.
Learn more about [Shopify Protect](https://www.shopify.com/protect).

fields.name: sourceIdentifier
fields.description:
A unique POS or third party order identifier.
For example, "1234-12-1000" or "111-98567-54". The [`receiptNumber`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Order#field-receiptNumber) field is derived from this value for POS orders.

fields.name: sourceName
fields.description: The name of the source associated with the order, such as "web", "mobile_app", or "pos". Use this field to identify the platform where the order was placed.

fields.name: staffMember
fields.description:
The staff member who created or is responsible for the order.
Useful for tracking which team member handled phone orders, manual orders, or order modifications.
Returns `null` for orders created directly by customers through the online store.

fields.name: statusPageUrl
fields.description:
The URL where customers can check their order's current status, including tracking information and delivery updates.
Provides order tracking links in emails, apps, or customer communications.

fields.name: subtotalLineItemsQuantity
fields.description:
The sum of quantities for all line items that contribute to the order's subtotal price.
This excludes quantities for items like tips, shipping costs, or gift cards that don't affect the subtotal.
Use this to quickly understand the total item count for pricing calculations.

fields.name: subtotalPrice
fields.description:
The sum of the prices for all line items after discounts and before returns, in shop currency.
If `taxesIncluded` is `true`, then the subtotal also includes tax.

fields.name: subtotalPriceSet
fields.description:
The sum of the prices for all line items after discounts and before returns, in shop and presentment currencies.
If `taxesIncluded` is `true`, then the subtotal also includes tax.

fields.name: suggestedRefund
fields.description:
A calculated refund suggestion for the order based on specified line items, shipping, and duties.
Use this to preview refund amounts, taxes, and processing fees before creating an actual refund.

fields.name: tags
fields.description:
A comma separated list of tags associated with the order. Updating `tags` overwrites
any existing tags that were previously added to the order. To add new tags without overwriting
existing tags, use the [tagsAdd](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/tagsadd)
mutation.

fields.name: taxExempt
fields.description:
Whether taxes are exempt on the order.
Returns `true` for orders where the customer or business has a valid tax exemption, such as non-profit organizations or tax-free purchases.
Use this to understand if tax calculations were skipped during checkout.

fields.name: taxLines
fields.description:
A list of all tax lines applied to line items on the order, before returns.
Tax line prices represent the total price for all tax lines with the same `rate` and `title`.

fields.name: taxesIncluded
fields.description:
Whether taxes are included in the subtotal price of the order.
When `true`, the subtotal and line item prices include tax amounts. When `false`, taxes are calculated and displayed separately.

fields.name: test
fields.description:
Whether the order is a test.
Test orders are made using the Shopify Bogus Gateway or a payment provider with test mode enabled.
A test order can't be converted into a real order and vice versa.

fields.name: totalCapturable
fields.description:
The authorized amount that's uncaptured or undercaptured, in shop currency.
This amount isn't adjusted for returns.

fields.name: totalCapturableSet
fields.description:
The authorized amount that's uncaptured or undercaptured, in shop and presentment currencies.
This amount isn't adjusted for returns.

fields.name: totalCashRoundingAdjustment
fields.description: The total rounding adjustment applied to payments or refunds for an order involving cash payments. Applies to some countries where cash transactions are rounded to the nearest currency denomination.

fields.name: totalDiscounts
fields.description:
The total amount discounted on the order before returns, in shop currency.
This includes both order and line level discounts.

fields.name: totalDiscountsSet
fields.description:
The total amount discounted on the order before returns, in shop and presentment currencies.
This includes both order and line level discounts.

fields.name: totalOutstandingSet
fields.description:
The total amount not yet transacted for the order, in shop and presentment currencies.
A positive value indicates a difference in the merchant's favor (payment from customer to merchant) and a negative value indicates a difference in the customer's favor (refund from merchant to customer).

fields.name: totalPrice
fields.description:
The total price of the order, before returns, in shop currency.
This includes taxes and discounts.

fields.name: totalPriceSet
fields.description:
The total price of the order, before returns, in shop and presentment currencies.
This includes taxes and discounts.

fields.name: totalReceived
fields.description: The total amount received from the customer before returns, in shop currency.

fields.name: totalReceivedSet
fields.description: The total amount received from the customer before returns, in shop and presentment currencies.

fields.name: totalRefunded
fields.description: The total amount that was refunded, in shop currency.

fields.name: totalRefundedSet
fields.description: The total amount that was refunded, in shop and presentment currencies.

fields.name: totalRefundedShippingSet
fields.description: The total amount of shipping that was refunded, in shop and presentment currencies.

fields.name: totalShippingPrice
fields.description: The total shipping amount before discounts and returns, in shop currency.

fields.name: totalShippingPriceSet
fields.description: The total shipping costs returned to the customer, in shop and presentment currencies. This includes fees and any related discounts that were refunded.

fields.name: totalTax
fields.description: The total tax amount before returns, in shop currency.

fields.name: totalTaxSet
fields.description: The total tax amount before returns, in shop and presentment currencies.

fields.name: totalTipReceived
fields.description: The sum of all tip amounts for the order, in shop currency.

fields.name: totalTipReceivedSet
fields.description: The sum of all tip amounts for the order, in shop and presentment currencies.

fields.name: totalWeight
fields.description: The total weight of the order before returns, in grams.

fields.name: transactions
fields.description: A list of transactions associated with the order.

fields.name: transactionsCount
fields.description: The number of transactions associated with the order.

fields.name: unpaid
fields.description: Whether no payments have been made for the order.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: The date and time in [ISO 8601 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) when the order was last modified.

fields.name: allocationLimit
fields.description: The maximum number of times that the price rule can be allocated onto an order.

fields.name: allocationMethod
fields.description: The method by which the price rule's value is allocated to its entitled items.

fields.name: app
fields.description: The application that created the price rule.

fields.name: combinesWith
fields.description:
The
[discount classes](https://help.shopify.com/manual/discounts/combining-discounts/discount-combinations)
that you can use in combination with
[Shopify discount types](https://help.shopify.com/manual/discounts/discount-types).

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The date and time when the price rule was created.

fields.name: customerSelection
fields.description: The customers that can use this price rule.

fields.name: discountClass
fields.description:
The
[discount class](https://help.shopify.com/manual/discounts/combining-discounts/discount-combinations)
that's used to control how discounts can be combined.

fields.name: discountClasses
fields.description: The classes of the discount.

fields.name: discountCodes
fields.description: List of the price rule's discount codes.

fields.name: discountCodesCount
fields.description: How many discount codes associated with the price rule.

fields.name: endsAt
fields.description: The date and time when the price rule ends. For open-ended price rules, use `null`.

fields.name: entitlementToPrerequisiteQuantityRatio
fields.description: Quantity of prerequisite items required for the price rule to be applicable,  compared to quantity of entitled items.

fields.name: events
fields.description: The paginated list of events associated with the price rule.

fields.name: features
fields.description: A list of the price rule's features.

fields.name: hasTimelineComment
fields.description: Indicates whether there are any timeline comments on the price rule.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: itemEntitlements
fields.description: The items to which the price rule applies.

fields.name: itemPrerequisites
fields.description: The items required for the price rule to be applicable.

fields.name: legacyResourceId
fields.description: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

fields.name: oncePerCustomer
fields.description: Whether the price rule can be applied only once per customer.

fields.name: prerequisiteQuantityRange
fields.description: The number of the entitled items must fall within this range for the price rule to be applicable.

fields.name: prerequisiteShippingPriceRange
fields.description: The shipping cost must fall within this range for the price rule to be applicable.

fields.name: prerequisiteSubtotalRange
fields.description: The sum of the entitled items subtotal prices must fall within this range for the price rule to be applicable.

fields.name: prerequisiteToEntitlementQuantityRatio
fields.description: Quantity of prerequisite items required for the price rule to be applicable,  compared to quantity of entitled items.

fields.name: shareableUrls
fields.description: URLs that can be used to share the discount.

fields.name: shippingEntitlements
fields.description: The shipping lines to which the price rule applies.

fields.name: startsAt
fields.description: The date and time when the price rule starts.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The status of the price rule.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: A detailed summary of the price rule.

fields.name: target
fields.description: The type of lines (line_item or shipping_line) to which the price rule applies.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The title of the price rule.

fields.name: totalSales
fields.description: The total sales from orders where the price rule was used.

fields.name: traits
fields.description: A list of the price rule's features.

fields.name: usageCount
fields.description: The number of times that the price rule has been used. This value is updated asynchronously and can be different than the actual usage count.

fields.name: usageLimit
fields.description: The maximum number of times that the price rule can be used in total.

fields.name: validityPeriod
fields.description: A time period during which a price rule is applicable.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The value of the price rule.

fields.name: valueV2
fields.description: The value of the price rule.

fields.name: availablePublicationsCount
fields.description:
The number of
[publications](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Publication)
that a resource is published to, without
[feedback errors](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/ResourceFeedback).

fields.name: bodyHtml
fields.description: The description of the product, with HTML tags. For example, the description might include bold `` and italic `` text.

fields.name: bundleComponents
fields.description:
A list of [components](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/product-merchandising/bundles/add-product-fixed-bundle)
that are associated with a product in a bundle.

fields.name: category
fields.description:
The category of a product
from [Shopify's Standard Product Taxonomy](https://shopify.github.io/product-taxonomy/releases/unstable/?categoryId=sg-4-17-2-17).

fields.name: collections
fields.description:
A list of [collections](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Collection)
that include the product.

fields.name: combinedListing
fields.description:
A special product type that combines separate products from a store into a single product listing.
[Combined listings](https://shopify.dev/apps/build/product-merchandising/combined-listings) are connected
by a shared option, such as color, model, or dimension.

fields.name: combinedListingRole
fields.description:
The [role of the product](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/product-merchandising/combined-listings/build-for-combined-listings)
in a combined listing.

If `null`, then the product isn't part of any combined listing.

fields.name: compareAtPriceRange
fields.description:
The [compare-at price range](https://help.shopify.com/manual/products/details/product-pricing/sale-pricing)
of the product in the shop's default currency.

fields.name: contextualPricing
fields.description: The pricing that applies to a customer in a specific context. For example, a price might vary depending on the customer's location. Only active markets are considered in the price resolution.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The date and time when the product was created.

fields.name: customProductType
fields.description: The custom product type specified by the merchant.

fields.name: defaultCursor
fields.description: A default [cursor](https://shopify.dev/api/usage/pagination-graphql) that returns the single next record, sorted ascending by ID.

fields.name: description
fields.description:
A single-line description of the product,
with [HTML tags](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML) removed.

fields.name: descriptionHtml
fields.description: The description of the product, with HTML tags. For example, the description might include bold `` and italic `` text.

fields.name: descriptionPlainSummary
fields.description:
Stripped description of the product, single line with HTML tags removed.
Truncated to 60 characters.

fields.name: events
fields.description: The paginated list of events associated with the host subject.

fields.name: featuredImage
fields.description: The featured image for the product.

fields.name: featuredMedia
fields.description:
The featured [media](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/online-store/product-media)
associated with the product.

fields.name: feedback
fields.description:
The information that lets merchants know what steps they need to take
to make sure that the app is set up correctly.

For example, if a merchant hasn't set up a product correctly in the app,
then the feedback might include a message that says "You need to add a price
to this product".

fields.name: giftCardTemplateSuffix
fields.description: The [theme template](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/themes/architecture/templates) that's used when customers view the gift card in a store.

fields.name: handle
fields.description:
A unique, human-readable string of the product's title. A handle can contain letters, hyphens (`-`), and numbers, but no spaces.
The handle is used in the online store URL for the product.

fields.name: hasOnlyDefaultVariant
fields.description: Whether the product has only a single variant with the default option and value.

fields.name: hasOutOfStockVariants
fields.description: Whether the product has variants that are out of stock.

fields.name: hasVariantsThatRequiresComponents
fields.description:
Whether at least one of the product variants requires
[bundle components](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/product-merchandising/bundles/add-product-fixed-bundle).

Learn more about
[store eligibility for bundles](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/product-merchandising/bundles#store-eligibility).

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: images
fields.description: The images associated with the product.

fields.name: inCollection
fields.description:
Whether the product
is in a specified
[collection](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/collection).

fields.name: isGiftCard
fields.description: Whether the product is a gift card.

fields.name: legacyResourceId
fields.description: The ID of the corresponding resource in the REST Admin API.

fields.name: media
fields.description: The [media](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/online-store/product-media) associated with the product. Valid media are images, 3D models, videos.

fields.name: mediaCount
fields.description:
The total count of [media](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/online-store/product-media)
that's associated with a product.

fields.name: metafield
fields.description:
A [custom field](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data),
including its `namespace` and `key`, that's associated with a Shopify resource

types.name: LineItem
types.description:
The `LineItem` object represents a single product or service that a customer purchased in an
[order](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Order).
Each line item is associated with a
[product variant](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/ProductVariant)
and can have multiple [discount allocations](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/DiscountAllocation).
Line items contain details about what was purchased, including the product variant, quantity, pricing,
and fulfillment status.

Use the `LineItem` object to manage the following processes:

- [Track the quantity of items](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/orders-fulfillment/order-management-apps/build-fulfillment-solutions) ordered, fulfilled, and unfulfilled.
- [Calculate prices](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/orders-fulfillment/order-management-apps/edit-orders), including discounts and taxes.
- Manage fulfillment through [fulfillment services](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/orders-fulfillment/fulfillment-service-apps).
- Manage [returns](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/orders-fulfillment/returns-apps/build-return-management) and [exchanges](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/orders-fulfillment/returns-apps/manage-exchanges).
- Handle [subscriptions](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/purchase-options/subscriptions) and recurring orders.

Line items can also include custom attributes and properties, allowing merchants to add specific details
about each item in an order. Learn more about
[managing orders and fulfillment](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/orders-fulfillment).

This is a third-party fulfillment service in the following scenarios:

**Scenario 1**
- The product variant is stocked by a single fulfillment service.
- The [FulfillmentService](/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/FulfillmentService) is a third-party fulfillment service. Third-party fulfillment services don't have a handle with the value `manual`.

**Scenario 2**
- Multiple fulfillment services stock the product variant.
- The last time that the line item was unfulfilled, it was awaiting fulfillment by a third-party fulfillment service. Third-party fulfillment services don't have a handle with the value `manual`.

If none of the above conditions are met, then the fulfillment service has the `manual` handle.
fields.deprecationReason:
The [relationship between a product variant and a fulfillment service was changed](/changelog/fulfillment-service-sku-sharing). A [ProductVariant](/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/ProductVariant) can be stocked by multiple fulfillment services. As a result, we recommend that you use the [inventoryItem field](/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/ProductVariant#field-productvariant-inventoryitem) if you need to determine where a product variant is stocked.

If you need to determine whether a product is a gift card, then you should continue to use this field until an alternative is available.

Altering the locations which stock a product variant won't change the value of this field for existing orders.

Learn about [managing inventory quantities and states](/apps/fulfillment/inventory-management-apps/quantities-states).

types.name: Location
types.description:
Represents the location where the physical good resides. You can stock inventory at active locations. Active
locations that have `fulfills_online_orders: true` and are configured with a shipping rate, pickup enabled or
local delivery will be able to sell from their storefront.

fields.name: activatable
fields.description:
Whether the location can be reactivated. If `false`, then trying to activate the location with the
[`LocationActivate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/locationActivate)
mutation will return an error that describes why the location can't be activated.

fields.name: address
fields.description: The address of this location.

fields.name: addressVerified
fields.description: Whether the location address has been verified.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The date and time ([ISO 8601 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)) that the location was added to a shop.

fields.name: deactivatable
fields.description:
Whether this location can be deactivated. If `true`, then the location can be deactivated by calling the
[`LocationDeactivate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/locationDeactivate)
mutation. If `false`, then calling the mutation to deactivate it will return an error that describes why the
location can't be deactivated.

fields.name: deactivatedAt
fields.description: The date and time ([ISO 8601 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)) that the location was deactivated at. For example, 3:30 pm on September 7, 2019 in the time zone of UTC (Universal Time Coordinated) is represented as `"2019-09-07T15:50:00Z`".

fields.name: deletable
fields.description: Whether this location can be deleted.

fields.name: fulfillmentService
fields.description: Name of the service provider that fulfills from this location.

fields.name: fulfillsOnlineOrders
fields.description: Whether this location can fulfill online orders.

fields.name: hasActiveInventory
fields.description: Whether this location has active inventory.

fields.name: hasUnfulfilledOrders
fields.description: Whether this location has orders that need to be fulfilled.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: inventoryLevel
fields.description: The quantities of an inventory item at this location.

fields.name: inventoryLevels
fields.description: A list of the quantities of the inventory items that can be stocked at this location.

fields.name: isActive
fields.description:
Whether the location is active. A deactivated location can be activated (change `isActive: true`) if it has
`activatable` set to `true` by calling the
[`locationActivate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/locationActivate)
mutation.

fields.name: isFulfillmentService
fields.description: Whether this location is a fulfillment service.

fields.name: isPrimary
fields.description: Whether the location is your primary location for shipping inventory.
fields.deprecationReason: The concept of a primary location is deprecated, shipsInventory can be used to get a fallback location

types.name: Market
types.description:
A market is a group of one or more regions that you want to target for international sales.
By creating a market, you can configure a distinct, localized shopping experience for
customers from a specific area of the world. For example, you can
[change currency](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/current/mutations/marketCurrencySettingsUpdate),
[configure international pricing](https://shopify.dev/apps/internationalization/product-price-lists),
or [add market-specific domains or subfolders](https://shopify.dev/api/admin-graphql/current/objects/MarketWebPresence).

Whether the market is enabled to receive visitors and sales. **Note**: Regions in inactive
markets can't be selected on the storefront or in checkout.

The market’s price list, which specifies a percentage-based price adjustment as well as
fixed price overrides for specific variants.

Markets with multiple catalogs can have multiple price lists. To query which price lists are connected to
a market, please query for price lists through the catalogs connection.

The market’s web presence, which defines its SEO strategy. This can be a different domain,
subdomain, or subfolders of the primary domain. Each web presence comprises one or more
language variants. If a market doesn't have its own web presence, then the market is accessible on the
primary market's domains using [country
selectors](https://shopify.dev/themes/internationalization/multiple-currencies-languages#the-country-selector).
If it's the primary market and it has multiple web presences, then this field will return the primary domain web presence.

types.name: MarketWebPresence
types.description:
The market’s web presence, which defines its SEO strategy. This can be a different domain
(e.g. `example.ca`), subdomain (e.g. `ca.example.com`), or subfolders of the primary
domain (e.g. `example.com/en-ca`). Each web presence comprises one or more language
variants. If a market does not have its own web presence, it is accessible on the shop’s
primary domain via [country
selectors](https://shopify.dev/themes/internationalization/multiple-currencies-languages#the-country-selector).

Note: while the domain/subfolders defined by a market’s web presence are not applicable to
custom storefronts, which must manage their own domains and routing, the languages chosen
here do govern [the languages available on the Storefront
API](https://shopify.dev/custom-storefronts/internationalization/multiple-languages) for the countries in
this market.

fields.name: alternateLocales
fields.description:
The ShopLocale object for the alternate locales. When a domain is used, these locales will be
available as language-specific subfolders. For example, if English is an
alternate locale, and `example.ca` is the market’s domain, then
`example.ca/en` will load in English.

fields.name: defaultLocale
fields.description:
The ShopLocale object for the default locale. When a domain is used, this is the locale that will
be used when the domain root is accessed. For example, if French is the default locale,
and `example.ca` is the market’s domain, then `example.ca` will load in French.

fields.name: domain
fields.description:
The web presence’s domain.
This field will be null if `subfolderSuffix` isn't null.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.

fields.name: market
fields.description: The associated market. This can be null for a web presence that isn't associated with a market.

fields.name: markets
fields.description: The associated markets for this web presence.

fields.name: rootUrls
fields.description: The list of root URLs for each of the web presence’s locales. As of version `2024-04` this value will no longer have a trailing slash.

fields.name: subfolderSuffix
fields.description: The market-specific suffix of the subfolders defined by the web presence. Example: in `/en-us` the subfolder suffix is `us`. This field will be null if `domain` isn't null.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A globally-unique ID.
